title: J1939 Receive
text: Receive J1939 parameter group messages, 2 outputs, {Destination Address Filter} sets Filter out message based on destination address global and node; {Config name} sets the name of the J1939 network configuration to associate, {Node name} sets the name of the J1939, {Parameter Group} sets the parameter group number, {Signals}, {Source Address Filter} sets the filter messages based on source address Allow, {Sample time} sets the simulation refresh rate and {Output New Message Received status} sets the create a Msg Status output. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Config name
params.values: Name of the J1939 network configuration to associate ConfigX (default) | character vector

params.name: Node name
params.values: Name of the J1939 node NodeX (default) | character vector

params.name: Parameter Group
params.values: Parameter group number (PGN) and name from database character vector

params.name: Signals
params.values: Signals defined in the parameter group array of character vectors

params.name: Source Address Filter
params.values: Filter messages based on source address Allow all (default) | Allow only

params.name: Destination Address Filter
params.values: Filter out message based on destination address global and node specific (default) | global only | node specific only
